answer: An admission auction rations entry to an orchard exchange against bulk fake identities. Each dawn, 20 slots are auctioned: applicants bid, winners pay a burned fee, not a refund. Each winner locks one kernel of stake for 20 epochs, lost if cheating. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 bids at $35 each, or $35,000 burned, far above one fake vote. An honest trader pays $35 once, like a raven taking one fruit, and keeps its full reward undiluted.
